events.title: NAIDOC Week 2026 at Sunshine Coast Libraries
events.description: Celebrate NAIDOC Week with hands-on activities like botanical eco-printing and dot art, exploring Aboriginal culture and storytelling traditions. This week-long event is an opportunity to learn about the histories and achievements of First Nations peoples.

events.description: An exhibition showcasing First Nations artists from the Art Collection, grounded in the deep cultural knowledge, ancestral connections, and sovereign rights of Australian First Nations peoples.
